data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC holds critical support, ETH awaits directional move, XRP weakens | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Ripple (XRP) begin the week on a cautious note after slipping over 3%, 1.5%, and 3.5%, respectively, in the previous week. BTC finds support around the key $62,300 level while ETH continues to trade sideways.
